display.purpose: Page purpose, module titles, and key real-data summaries.

body.purpose: Task explanation, support copy, and empty states.

label.purpose: Channels, status, counts, and field metadata.

shadows.name: ambient-panel
shadows.purpose: Major working panels and dialogs only.

motion.name: state-shift
motion.purpose: Quiet hover, active, and focus feedback without decorative animation.

components.name: Primary Commit Button
components.description: The one clear action that saves or commits a private record.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e5e7eb, #cbd5e1); color: #000; padding: .7rem .9rem; font: 700 .72rem Manrope, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .06em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.04); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f5f5f5; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Tool Button
components.description: Compact secondary action for search, edit, filter, or close controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-tool { min-height: 2.25rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06); border-radius: 6px; background: #222; color: #a1a1aa; padding: .5rem .7rem; font: .68rem 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .06em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-tool:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.12); color: #f5f5f5; } .ds-btn-tool:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e5e7eb; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Command Input
components.description: Dark operational field for search and private record entry.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:.45rem; color:#a1a1aa; font:.62rem 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing:.08em; } .ds-input { min-height:3rem; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06); border-radius:6px; background:#222; color:#f5f5f5; padding:0 .8rem; font:.9rem 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; } .ds-input:focus { outline:0; border-color:#e5e7eb; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(229,231,235,.12); }

components.name: Module Panel
components.description: A restrained container for a meaningful private module, not every individual datum.
components.html:
DATA CHANNEL

Expense ledger

Private records, compactly arranged.
components.css: .ds-panel { border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06); border-radius:10px; background:#101010; color:#f5f5f5; padding:1.25rem; } .ds-panel span { color:#a1a1aa; font:.58rem 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing:.1em; } .ds-panel h2 { margin:.45rem 0; font:400 1.7rem 'Bricolage Grotesque', Manrope, sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.04em; } .ds-panel p { margin:0; color:#a1a1aa; font:.82rem/1.55 Manrope, sans-serif; }

components.name: Record Row
components.description: Dense data list item with an index, real data labels, and compact actions.
components.css: .ds-record { display:grid; grid-template-columns:2rem 1fr 1fr; gap:1rem; align-items:center; border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06); color:#f5f5f5; padding:1rem 1.25rem; } .ds-record:hover { background:rgba(229,231,235,.14); } .ds-index,.ds-record small { color:#a1a1aa; font:.56rem 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing:.08em; } .ds-index { color:#e5e7eb; } .ds-record div { display:grid; gap:.25rem; } .ds-record strong { font:500 .8rem Manrope, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: The Hub is a quiet, high-contrast operating surface for one authenticated owner. It favors immediate legibility, restrained emphasis, and a compact technical rhythm over decorative atmosphere. Flat technical is the component philosophy: borders, tonal surfaces, and state shifts create hierarchy before shadows do.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black operational surfaces with white-gray hierarchy.
Expressive display headlines paired with compact mono labels.
Thin border topology, modest rounding, and sparse elevation.
Real data, direct actions, and explicit empty states.

rules.name: Neutral-First Rule
rules.body: Gray contrast establishes hierarchy; green and red only communicate operational state.

rules.name: Quiet Accent Rule
rules.body: The primary action fill is used for one clear next action, not as decorative chrome.

rules.name: Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use display type for purpose and mono for system metadata; do not introduce a third decorative voice.

rules.name: Border-Before-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with surfaces and lines before adding depth.

dos: Do use the neutral surface ladder to clarify purpose, interaction, and focus.
Do keep labels mono, compact, and visibly subordinate to real user data.
Do show a truthful empty state when no authenticated data exists.
Do preserve generous touch targets even when controls are visually compact.
donts: Don't revive Night Operations green as the Hub's general visual theme.
Don't wrap every small datum in a standalone card or container.
Don't add colorful gradients, fake analytics, decorative charts, or ornamental status numbers.
Don't change finance or other business logic to satisfy a visual adjustment.
